patches.name: FillAIDangerMap Efficiency Fix 20200706
patches.title: FillAIDangerMap efficiency fix
patches.nameJp: FillAIDangerMapの効率修正 20200706
patches.description: When generating AI units' movement, the game uses a nested for loop to iterate through each red unit, and then check the strength of every ally unit that could potentially reach it in the next turn.  This causes a small amount of lag in the vanilla games, but for hacks using the Modular Stat Getters (especially with skill system), the strength getter increases in complexity from a single function call to dozens of nested function calls, ballooning the load on the CPU.
patches.summary: Speeds up enemy movement calculation, avoiding heavy lag in hacks with modular stat getters or skill systems.
patches.author: HyperGammaSpaces

patches.description: This patch is solves problems that arise when doing a massive remodeling that will go around both continents, such as going to both routes the Carcino and Grado routes. patches.title: Ending turn list dividers
patches.nameJp: エンディングのクリアターン一覧に編ごとの区切り文字を追加する(Editor)
patches.description: As you scroll through the list of clear turns, if the current value in the list matches the chapter ID you are trying to display, display that string and advance the current value in the list by one.  So, if the chapter mentioned in the list does not appear in a gaiden or similar, no further matches will be made.
patches.summary: Edits the strings shown before given chapters in the ending's clear turn list. Each entry matches a chapter ID and advances the list by one.

patches.name: Add delimiter for each edition to the clear turn list of the ending(Installer)
patches.title: Ending clear-turn list dividers
patches.nameJp: エンディングのクリアターン一覧に編ごとの区切り文字を追加する(Installer)
patches.description: When displaying a list of clear turns for an ending, display a specific string of characters before displaying the specified chapter ID You can create separations such as Part 1 and Part 2.  Tables should always be arranged in ascending order by the chapter they are displayed in.
patches.summary: Shows a chosen text string before a given chapter in the ending's clear-turn list, so it can be split into parts like Part 1 and Part 2.
